summary: FCLR-001 forecast gate NOT MET (PILOT/INCONCLUSIVE). Risk-overlay INELIGIBLE. Direct liquidation labels unavailable. Frontier lists unfinished tasks ordered by information gain; none may reuse the sealed holdout for selection.

frontier.task: Pre-registered FCLR-002: extend out-of-sample evaluation to >=3 non-overlapping 30-day blocks across >=5 instruments
frontier.prerequisite: New protocol version FCLR-002 v1.0 registered BEFORE any outcomes computed; sufficient historical coverage (data beyond 2024-03-31 or a re-partitioned panel) confirmed by coverage-only audit
frontier.acceptance: >=5 instruments in paired OOS panel; >=3 non-overlapping 30-day blocks; block-bootstrap uncertainty supporting improvement after multiplicity correction; >=2% relative QLIKE on primary contrast C2 vs B1
frontier.blockers: Frozen FCLR-001 coverage is 2024-01-01..2024-03-31; current test window is a single ~4-day block. Extending the window requires new admissible source downloads and a re-frozen split.
frontier.do_not: Do not reuse the FCLR-001 sealed holdout for selection, tuning, or re-evaluation.

frontier.task: Enumerate and test additional admissible public liquidation sources (Track A)
frontier.acceptance: Documented unauthenticated download path, temporal coverage, schema, completeness diagnostics, license/terms for at least one source; or a documented verdict that Track A is unviable
frontier.blockers: Binance liquidationSnapshot archive HTTP 404; fapi forceOrders returns 451 restricted location
frontier.do_not: Do not infer event-free intervals from missing data; do not accept a capped/partial event stream as a complete census.

frontier.task: Register margin/leverage scenarios and run out-of-sample hypothetical boundary-breach forecast (FCLR-H003)
frontier.prerequisite: New protocol version registering each margin/leverage scenario BEFORE outcome inspection; synthetic boundary labels already implemented (scripts/synthetic_boundary_labels.py, 5/5 tests)
frontier.acceptance: Pre-registered scenarios; Brier/log-loss/calibration/precision-recall reported; long and short labels kept separate; funding/fee/price-reference assumptions disclosed
frontier.blockers: FCLR-001 forecast gate not met; boundary forecast is a separate hypothesis and does not unblock the risk-overlay phase
frontier.do_not: Do not describe modeled boundary breaches as observed liquidations.

frontier.task: Obtain and document the Shek (SSRN, posted 29 Sep 2026) full methodology to convert FCLR-H002 from PARTIAL to exact replication
frontier.prerequisite: Paper's event definition, censoring rules, volatility-regime split, and contract set
frontier.acceptance: Independent reconstruction of the full methodology from admissible sources; otherwise remain PARTIAL and do not promote the correction-time association
frontier.blockers: Full methodology not independently reconstructible from public sources alone
frontier.do_not: Do not conflate correction time with volatility forecast skill, boundary breaches, or observed liquidations.

frontier.task: Adversarial re-audit of any FCLR-002 panel before its holdout is opened
frontier.acceptance: All 11 leakage-audit checklist items re-run on the new panel; no unresolved defect
frontier.do_not: Do not open the FCLR-002 holdout before the audit passes.
